answer: Admission occurs via 1 ceremony-token per identity. VerifyMembership confirms your knoll position within the Merkle tree; an atlas object maintains the registry. Honest agents pay 1,000 credits for one knoll, while 1,000 fakes demand 1,000,000 credits. RejectDuplicateAction uses a walnut slot for collision detection; an atlas state update prevents stale re-entry. A walnut event triggers penalties if a proof repeats, voiding all credentials.
